source_name: FinTechZone.hu — Hungarian fintech news portal
why_relevant: Publishes vendor-supplied backgrounders on Hungarian bank launches (e.g. the technology stack behind neobank Trive Bank) and maintains a PSD2 / fintech-regulation category linking rule changes to implementation projects. Good bridge between regulation topics and supplier identities.

source_name: Magyar Bankszövetség — Sajtóközlemények (Hungarian Banking Association press releases)
why_relevant: Industry association whose press releases and position papers reveal which regulatory deadlines the private banks are collectively preparing for, and occasionally which shared/sector-level technical projects (AFR, qvik, data reporting) are being procured. A pointer into the demand side that the banks themselves do not publish.

source_name: MNB press releases (EN) — enforcement and supervisory actions naming banks
why_relevant: MNB fines against OTP and MBH for AML/CTF shortcomings are the strongest public predictor of imminent compliance-driven procurement (transaction monitoring, screening, KYC). Pair with vendor newsrooms to time the buying cycle.

source_name: Vixio Regulatory Intelligence — payments news blog (Hungary coverage)
why_relevant: Commercial regulatory-intelligence vendor whose free blog summarises Hungarian regulator actions (e.g. MNB AML fines on key banks). Useful English-language early-warning layer over MNB output; the paid product is itself an aggregator worth mapping.

source_name: CMS Law-Now — Hungary financial regulatory e-alerts
why_relevant: Law-firm alerts on new MNB obligations (e.g. additional AML duties for crypto-asset service providers) name the rule, the deadline and the affected institution type — the compliance trigger that later shows up as a vendor case study.

source_name: Kyndryl — Customer stories directory
why_relevant: Global infrastructure-services vendor with a searchable customer-story directory; the class of source (managed-services provider reference pages) is exactly where Hungarian bank infrastructure/outsourcing engagements surface, given MNB outsourcing rules require documented provider arrangements. Hungary-specific entry not yet confirmed.

source_name: GIRO Zrt. — operator of AFR/GIROInstant and qvik infrastructure
why_relevant: MNB-owned clearing house running the instant payment rails every Hungarian bank must connect to. Its notices, technical specifications and participant/partner information are the mandatory-compliance hook that forces bank-side vendor spend on AFR/qvik integration (AFR 2.0 next).

source_name: Bank-side AFR/qvik customer notices (e.g. Oberbank Hungary AFR ügyféltájékoztató, MBH Duna Bank)
why_relevant: Smaller Hungarian banks publish detailed Hungarian-language AFR/qvik customer notices and T&C changes that reveal implementation timing, scope and sometimes the processing partner — an indirect read on the bank's technical dependencies where no procurement notice exists.

source_name: ABT Hungária — client news (OTP Bank qvik services)
why_relevant: Advisory/service firm publishing news items tied to OTP's qvik rollout — an example of the professional-services layer that names bank projects. Illustrates the wider class of Hungarian advisory firms whose news sections leak bank implementation detail.

source_name: Trademagazin / Daily News Hungary / XpatLoop — qvik and merchant-payments rollout coverage
why_relevant: Retail/trade and general press covering qvik go-lives at named merchants and banks, occasionally naming the developer/technology provider behind the rollout — a merchant-side indirect route into acquiring-side supplier identities.

source_name: Profession.hu — Hungarian market-leading job board (banking/compliance ads)
why_relevant: Estimated ~90% revenue share of the HU job-ad market; nearly every Hungarian bank, PSP and consultancy posts compliance/regulatory-reporting/AML roles here. Ads are dated, in Hungarian, and often name the driving programme (DORA, AFR/qvik, MNB adatszolgáltatas, AML/KYC), giving months of lead time on regulatory programmes. Company pages (e.g. /cegek/giro-zrt/allasok) allow per-institution tracking.

source_name: Indeed Hungary (hu.indeed.com) — aggregated HU banking/AML job ads
why_relevant: Aggregates ads from bank career portals and smaller boards, including postings that never appear on profession.hu. Query-string URLs make per-keyword and per-employer monitoring trivial (e.g. AML, MNB, MBH Bank, Erste, Deloitte). Good breadth check for weak signals across second-tier institutions and vendors.

source_name: OTP Bank Nyrt. career portal (karrier.otpbank.hu)
why_relevant: Hungary's largest bank and the single most informative institution for regulatory-programme staffing. Own ATS listing (SAP SuccessFactors-style paths /viewalljobs/, /go/...) exposes full open-role inventory including compliance, regulatory reporting, payments and IT-risk roles before/instead of board syndication.

source_name: MBH Bank career portal (karrier.mbhbank.hu / mbhbank.hu/karrier)
why_relevant: Hungary's second-largest bank, formed by the MKB/Takarék/Budapest Bank merger — an integration-heavy institution whose ads reveal migration, AML/fraud-system operation, and regulatory-reporting workstreams. Ads observed referencing fraud/AML system operations.

source_name: Erste Bank Hungary career portal (karrier.erstebank.hu)
why_relevant: Major foreign-owned universal bank; career site explicitly markets long-term Compliance career tracks and lists compliance coordinator roles in Budapest. Group-driven DORA/AML programme staffing tends to show here first in HU.

source_name: K&H Bank career portal (karrier.kh.hu)
why_relevant: KBC-owned top-5 HU bank; own job listing reveals payments, regulatory-reporting and compliance staffing driven by both MNB and group/EU (DORA, PSD3/PSR, instant payments) deadlines.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Zrt. career portal (raiffeisen.karrierportal.hu)
why_relevant: Top-tier HU bank on the shared 'karrierportal.hu' ATS platform (same platform as GIRO) — uniform listing structure makes multi-employer monitoring cheap. Reveals expert-level compliance/regulatory roles.

source_name: CIB Bank career portal
why_relevant: Intesa Sanpaolo-owned HU bank; portal lists roles from intern to leadership nationwide, incl. back-office/regulatory functions. Useful for spotting group-mandated regulatory programme rollouts landing in HU.

source_name: UniCredit Bank Hungary career pages
why_relevant: Group-driven regulatory staffing (DORA, AML package, instant payments/VoP) frequently appears as HU-based roles. Internship pipeline pages also indicate which functions are being scaled.

source_name: GIRO Zrt. career portal (giro.karrierportal.hu)
why_relevant: Highest-signal single employer for the payments workstream: GIRO (100% MNB-owned since 2014) operates the BKR interbank clearing system and the instant payment infrastructure. Any staffing for AFR/qvik/ISO 20022/VoP-type changes here precedes market-wide mandates by months.

source_name: Magyar Nemzeti Bank (MNB) careers page — 'Karrier / Álláslehetőségek'
why_relevant: The supervisor's own hiring is a leading indicator of supervisory capacity build-out: recruiting DORA/ICT-risk examiners, payments-oversight or data-reporting staff signals where inspection pressure and new adatszolgáltatás obligations are heading. Highest institutional credibility.

source_name: ESAs / EU-level DORA oversight recruitment announcements republished by MNB supervisory news
why_relevant: MNB republishes ESA staffing calls for the joint DORA oversight team (directors, legal experts, ICT-risk specialists). A supervisory news item about hiring is an explicit, dated pointer to when the DORA critical-third-party oversight machinery becomes operational — and a snowball entry into ESA/EBA/ESMA/EIOPA vacancy pages.

source_name: LinkedIn Jobs Hungary (hu.linkedin.com/jobs)
why_relevant: Best coverage of English-titled roles at Budapest shared-service/hub employers (Citi, Wise, Revolut, Big Four) and of recruiter/agency posts naming client programmes. Also captures organisational-change signals (new titles, team growth) beyond individual ads.

source_name: Citi Budapest careers — regulatory reporting roles (jobs.citi.com)
why_relevant: Citi's Budapest service centre is one of the largest concentrations of regulatory-reporting headcount in Hungary. Ad text explicitly references central-bank inspections and regulatory reporting scope, making it a readable proxy for reporting-obligation workload trends.

source_name: Wise Budapest careers / syndicated financial-crime role ads (builtin.com mirrors)
why_relevant: Wise runs a large Budapest financial-crime and regulatory-reporting operation; ads for SAR/financial-crime reporting specialists and a Regulatory Reporting Manager indicate where non-bank PSP compliance load is growing under MNB and multi-jurisdiction supervision. Syndicated mirrors are fetchable when the ATS is defended.

source_name: Deloitte Hungary careers — Risk & Regulatory / FSI consulting roles
why_relevant: Consultancy staffing is the cell's purest lead indicator: Deloitte HU advertising Risk & Regulatory analysts/consultants for Financial Services, and banking-focused cybersecurity consultants, means banks have bought or are about to buy regulatory-programme capacity (DORA, AML package, reporting).

source_name: KPMG Hungary careers (kpmg.com/hu/hu/karrier.html)
why_relevant: KPMG HU (incl. the KGSH global compliance centre in Budapest) staffs regulatory and compliance delivery teams; ad volume and specialisation are a proxy for which regulatory workstreams clients are outsourcing.
